
Two arXiv papers from the RSS feed meet the inclusion criteria with high confidence. Agentao directly implements a governed local-first runtime for tool-using agents (execution loop, tool dispatch, safety constraints). The agentic learning harness evaluation paper addresses harness capability assessment methodology. No Grok social signals qualified this cycle.

## Suggestions

- [Agentao: A Governed Local-First Runtime for Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13574) — Proposes a governed local-first runtime for tool-using LLM agents, implementing execution loop management, tool dispatch, and governance constraints at the harness layer.
  Section: Research Papers > Agent-Computer Interfaces & Scaffolding Design | Criteria: Defines or implements the execution loop, scaffolding, or runtime environment that hosts an AI agent, Manages tool dispatch, context handling, state management, or safety constraints at the harness layer, Empirical or production evidence of harness design improving reliability, safety, or performance

- [Evaluating Agentic Learning Harness Capabilities Without Labels via the Scaling Hypothesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13608) — Proposes a label-free methodology for evaluating agentic learning harness capabilities using the scaling hypothesis, advancing harness-mediated agent evaluation without ground-truth supervision.
  Section: Research Papers > Evaluation Harness Design | Criteria: Evaluates or benchmarks agent behavior through controlled harness-mediated interactions, Defines or implements the execution loop, scaffolding, or runtime environment that hosts an AI agent, Empirical or production evidence of harness design improving reliability, safety, or performance
